title: GNU sparse TAR extraction starts at the first data record
summary: An aligned sparse TAR map now produced three zeros followed by ABCD. Replacing the data with WXYZ preserved the next member’s name, payload and end of archive.

change.description: An aligned GNU PAX 1.x sparse map occupies complete TAR records. The merge consumes zero padding when the last map byte already ends a 512-byte record.

notes: The file data and the next member have independent TAR boundaries. Successful delivery of the first file alone does not prove subsequent alignment.
